DIAGNOSIS READY: Ureteral Calculus (Right Kidney Stone) with Hydronephrosis.

The ultrasound confirmed dilation of the right renal collecting system, and your description of potential "gravel" in the urine, combined with the flank pain and hematuria, strongly suggests a kidney stone obstructing the ureter. The urine culture was requested to rule out a concurrent infection, but the clinical picture is classic for a stone. Is there any history of recurrent stones or family history of kidney stones?
